summary: Iter19 SAWALI — Admin WA phone bug-fix + portal WA schedule CRUD + OpenAI Whisper transcribe + media target_client_id + version_stamp settings. BACKEND: 18 passed + 2 skipped (0 failed) in /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter19.py (~4.8s). Coverage across 7 classes: (A) TestNormalizePhone — imports server._normalize_wa_phone and confirms digits-only output for '+228 90-12.34(56)' → '22890123456', '+1 (555) 123-4567' → '15551234567', and '' / None → '' (no crash). (B) TestBulkSend — POST /api/admin/messaging/bulk-send: empty recipients 400, missing template 422, response includes error_summary list (unique error strings, capped at 3), per-recipient results array with ok/status/error/label. Verified with 2 bad phones + bogus template → sent_ok=0 and error_summary non-empty. (C) TestPortalSchedules — /api/me/messaging/schedules: list requires auth (401/403); admin can list; POST validates empty recipients (400), empty template (422), past date (400 'futur'), bogus ISO (400 'iso/date'); full happy CRUD: admin creates a schedule (status=pending, created_by_id=admin.id), appears in list, DELETE returns status='deleted' (pending → hard delete), disappears from list; unknown id returns 404. (D) TestTranscribe — requires auth; with no openai_api_key configured in settings (confirmed via sync pymongo read) returns 503 with French detail 'Transcription audio non configurée. Demandez à l\'admin d\'ajouter une clé OpenAI dans /admin/settings.' ✓; empty audio test skipped when no key (503 short-circuits before size check). (E) TestMediaLibraryTarget — admin can pass target_client_id=<other-client.id> in multipart form and the media_library doc is stored with client_id=<other-client.id> (verified via sync mongo). Non-admin override-ignored test skipped (no seeded non-admin password). (F) TestCompanyInfoVersionStamp — GET /api/company-info now includes version_stamp: {color, size in {xs,sm,md,lg}, opacity int, style in {normal,bold,italic,bold_italic}} ✓. (G) TestAdminSettingsNewFields — PUT /api/admin/settings with {openai_api_key, openai_whisper_model, version_stamp_color, version_stamp_size, version_stamp_opacity, version_stamp_style} persists correctly; subsequent GET /api/admin/settings masks openai_api_key as '********'; raw DB shows the real key; /api/company-info reflects the new version_stamp; RESTORE fixture unsets openai_api_key and reverts version_stamp fields. FRONTEND (Playwright with admin JWT injected): /admin/settings renders Transcription audio (OpenAI Whisper) section + Version stamp (footer) section with all 7 testids (openai-api-key, openai-whisper-model, version-stamp-color, version-stamp-size, version-stamp-opacity, version-stamp-style, version-stamp-preview); preview span updates live (fill color=#00aa55 → preview style 'color: rgb(0, 170, 85); opacity: 0.7; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal') ✓. /portal/contacts shows the new 'Mess. Program.' (blue, CalendarClock) + 'Hist. Mess.' buttons per row alongside the green WhatsApp one; click on 'Mess. Program.' opens [data-testid=schedule-modal] ✓. /portal/media-library renders [data-testid=media-target-client] selector next to upload button for admin ✓. /portal/notes/reports form shows [data-testid=rte-mic-start] mic button in the RichEditor toolbar + WaMessagesPicker section ('Insérer des messages WhatsApp') below the editor ✓. VersionStamp pill [data-testid=version-stamp] is rendered bottom-left on every portal layout with computed style {color: rgb(100, 116, 139), fontSize: 10px, opacity: 0.7, fontWeight: 400, fontStyle: normal} — the default values from /api/company-info ✓.

integration_issues.issue: When WhatsApp Business API is not configured, the modal renders 'WhatsApp Business API non configurée.' banner and hides the template-select / date / time / schedule-list inputs entirely. This is consistent with the single-send modal pattern, but the four inner data-testids (schedule-template-select/date/time/list) only appear once WA is configured. Worth noting in specs — a skeleton or disabled-state form would let UI tests verify the fields without full Meta config.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The dev/emergent wrapper is injecting a <span data-ve-dynamic> inside each <option value="..."> in the author filter <select>. Functional but produces a console error on every /portal/notes/* page. Pre-existing before iter19 (the dev-only x-* attribute wrapper), LOW priority.

action_items: (LOW) /portal/contacts ScheduleModal shows only the 'WA non configurée' banner when Meta is not set up — consider rendering the form in a disabled skeleton state so admins can preview fields and QA can assert testids without needing a real Meta token.
(LOW, pre-existing) UserNotes.jsx author-filter <select> produces a React hydration warning (<span> inside <option> from dev-wrapper). Not caused by iter19, but should be tracked.
(LOW, carry-over iter17/18) server.py is ~8173 lines — overdue for router split (auth/admin/portal/forms/whatsapp/scheduler/automations/templates/timeline/crm_notes_tasks/policies/transcribe/db).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _normalize_wa_phone (~5124): clean, minimal — isdigit filter over str(raw). Handles None gracefully. Used by _wa_send_template before POST to Meta Graph → fixes the 'Vérifier le numéro' bug per the review request. ✓

server.py admin_messaging_bulk_send (~6130): error_summary collection is deduplicated via a seen set, capped at 3 entries, truncated at 240 chars per message. Good UX — frontend can show a compact 'Why it failed' without 1000-row noise. ✓

server.py me_create_schedule (~5450): correctly parses ISO-8601 including 'Z' suffix (replaced with '+00:00'), assumes UTC if no tz, rejects dates in the past with 1-minute grace window. created_by_id + created_by_role + client_id captured so the shared cron _run_scheduled_whatsapp can reuse the existing pipeline. ✓

server.py me_delete_schedule (~5494): non-admin scoping via created_by_id match — portal users can ONLY cancel their own schedules. Pending → hard delete; running/done → soft cancel. Correct semantics. ✓

server.py transcribe_audio (~2500): 503 with clear French message when key is missing — actionable for the admin. Uses httpx.AsyncClient with 25MB/200-byte size guards, delegates to OpenAI Whisper with multipart files + model + language form fields. Timeout 60s, TimeoutException → 504. ✓

server.py me_media_library_create (~2427): correctly scopes client_id = target_client_id ONLY when user.role=='admin'; non-admins fall back to user.client_id ||  user.id. Prevents privilege escalation by a non-admin. ✓
server.py company_info (~733): version_stamp dict exposed with sensible defaults (size='xs', opacity=70, style='normal'). Parsed via int(...) to guard against string storage. ✓

server.py admin_update_settings (~4234): adds openai_api_key to the masking set at line 4217 — subsequent GETs return '********' while the real key persists in db.settings. Matches the existing pattern for wa_access_token / smtp_password / etc. ✓
models.py SettingsUpdate: new fields declared as Optional[str|int] with proper ranges in docstring. ✓
VersionStamp.jsx / AdminSettings.jsx: consume /api/company-info version_stamp and update live via controlled form — preview span recomputes style on every change. ✓

Contacts.jsx ScheduleModal: well-isolated component, uses /api/me/messaging/schedules endpoints + /api/me/whatsapp/templates. Pending-row cancel button has data-testid=schedule-cancel-{id} for row-level testing. Portal users will see their own schedules only (server filters by created_by_id). ✓

UserNotes.jsx RichEditor mic button uses 3 distinct states (rte-mic-start, rte-mic-stop, rte-mic-processing) — gives clear visual feedback during idle/recording/uploading. Pulsing red while recording is a nice UX touch. ✓
MediaLibrary.jsx: [data-testid=media-target-client] dropdown only renders when user.role==='admin'. ✓

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 executed tests PASSED — 2 skipped by design: empty-audio branch unreachable without OPENAI key; non-admin target_client_id override requires a seeded non-admin password which isn't exposed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 12 new data-testids verified: 7 in AdminSettings, 1 VersionStamp pill, 1 Contacts contact-schedule-* button, 1 schedule-modal open, 1 media-target-client, 1 rte-mic-start + 1 wa-messages-picker)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@sawalismartsystems.com / Admin@Sawali2026 (OTP-dev flow, returns dev_otp because SMTP unconfigured). For UI run, JWT injected into localStorage (access_token/sawali_token/token/user/sawali_user) to bypass reCAPTCHA + OTP step.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seeds. Temporary schedules/media/settings created and cleaned up in each test via finally blocks + pymongo direct deletes. The admin_settings test backs up and RESTORES prev values (openai_whisper_model, version_stamp_*) and unsets openai_api_key at teardown so the subsequent iter runs still see transcribe 503.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter19 suite = /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter19.py (20 tests, ~5s). BASE URL is loaded from BOTH /app/backend/.env AND /app/frontend/.env via load_dotenv (backend/.env doesn't have REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Uses sync pymongo + MongoClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL']) for direct DB assertions. Patterns to reuse: (1) Session-scoped OTP login helper _login() that auto-handles needs_otp + dev_otp. (2) Finally block with _sync_db.<coll>.delete_one + PUT /api/admin/settings restore to avoid polluting shared settings. (3) monkeypatch.setattr on server._wa_send_template when a test needs deterministic ok=True — not used in this iter but planned. Endpoints added in iter19: POST /api/transcribe (auth; 503 no key); GET/POST/DELETE /api/me/messaging/schedules; admin POST /api/admin/messaging/bulk-send now returns error_summary. Models.SettingsUpdate gained openai_api_key / openai_whisper_model / version_stamp_{color,size,opacity,style}. The admin test RESTORES openai_api_key=<unset> — if future tests need a real key, set it explicitly then unset.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The iter19 spec (WA phone sanitization, portal schedule CRUD, transcribe stub + 503 gating, admin target_client_id override, version_stamp exposure) is cleanly implemented. _normalize_wa_phone is a 3-line digits-only filter — the original 'Vérifier le numéro' bug in Meta's response was caused by '+' / spaces / parens leaking into the 'to' field, and stripping them via isdigit() is the correct fix. The portal schedule endpoints reuse the existing whatsapp_schedules collection + APScheduler cron (_run_scheduled_whatsapp) — no duplicate cron needed. The transcribe endpoint correctly 503s when the admin hasn't set the key, with a French action message pointing to /admin/settings. VersionStamp pill uses CSS variables driven by /api/company-info → admin updates reflect everywhere immediately.
